<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.39.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Add icon to `st.button` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9301
* Add icon to `st.download_button` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9322
* Add icon to `st.form_submit_button` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9327
* Add `st.logo` size options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9177
* [feat] Add `icon` to `st.link_button` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9350
* Add icon to `st.popover` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9367
* Allow setting CSS class on elements via `key` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9295
* Add config option to set TTL for disconnected sessions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9179
* Add .pdf to the list of safe static files by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9439
* Feature: Add `enter_to_submit` param to `st.form` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9480
* Add expanded param to st.navigation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9484
* [feat] Add width and height to st.{map|pydeck_chart} by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9464
* [feat] Utilize new fullscreen Toolbar for st.{map|pydeck_chart} by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9501
* [feat] Selection on `st.pydeck_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9377
* st.experimental_audio_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9404
* Support hierarchical (multi-index) column headers in `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9483
* Prefer column config formatting over Pandas styler by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9538
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Multiselect label truncation in narrow columns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9334
* [fix] `st.{balloons|snow}` fixes when rendered in `st.dialog` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9335
* Remove `st.logo` if stale by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9337
* Fix issue with re-adding deleted row in data editor with same index by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8864
* Fix: Margin on button icons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9378
* Do not format title for MPAv2 in Sidebar nav by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9375
* Fix dialogs not re-opening in some cases after dismiss by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9333
* Fix edge case where title can be empty string by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9374
* Update runtime.py: change [EMAIL] to [EMAIL] by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9371
* Fix: Make `showSidebarNavigation` config work in MPAv2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9379
* Determine common mime types by extension by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9390
* Fix bold font in header showing less weight by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9395
* Update page script hash on script start if necessary by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9408
* Update overflowing pages to be more deterministic by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9394
* Fix accidentally watching parent folder for changes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9453
* Fix: Disable form submission & instructions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9406
* Do not clear nodes for fragment-finished-via-rerun messages by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9389
* Clear queue also for fragment-runs to prevent vanishing elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9381
* Migrate Active Script hash to ScriptRunContext by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9441
* Fix dataframe maximum update depth error  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9490
* Add warning for nested paths in url path by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9499
* [fix] Remove unneeded margin on map components by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9506
* Redirect pages with removed trailing slashes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9500
* Fix `st.json` to keep container bounds by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9521
* [Fix] `st.multiselect` placeholder by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9523
* [Fix] Embedded app spacing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9524
* [fix] DeckGl zoom button borders and styling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9536
### Other Changes
* Allow tenacity version 9.x by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9348
* [Fix] Logo maintains aspect ratio on width resize by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9368
* [Fix] Logo blink on MPA v1 page change by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9361
* Update watchdog so Streamlit can use version 5.X by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9354
* Fix: Material icon color in buttons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9393
* Adding more specific exceptions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9318
* Add missing `in` operator to docstring example by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9413
* Update vega frontend dependencies to support new features by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9443
* Remove fullscreen button for `st.bokeh_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9528

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9390
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9413

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.38.0...1.39.0
